CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   B. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   D. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

4. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft.

5. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. The ticket price

7. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

8. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

10. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

11. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.

12. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   C. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Middle Distance Races and Montage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Netball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fabric Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. C — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. B — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. A — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. B — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. C — The speed of the music

7. C — Red, blue, and yellow

8. D — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. A — Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. C — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. C — Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. D — Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Middle Distance Races and Montage; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Netball; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Fabric Decoration; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
